GET VYBE

Install on Android.

  1. Download the APK

    Open this page on your Android phone and download Vybe.apk from GitHub.

  2. Open the file

    Tap the APK in Downloads. If Android asks, allow installs from the browser or file manager you used.

  3. Install and listen

    Tap Install, then open Vybe and search for a song or import a public Spotify playlist.
